title: SOL-82 in the arsenal: the pass clock after the handover, the seat on the views strip, the beam through the game's own kill, seal and breach paths
context: Owner: 'we officially add the Orbital Laser to our arsenal of tools to defend the base.' V1 session design section 3 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-15-v1-session-design.md): online from sector 2, passes on the lab's clock, the strip counts down and lights overhead, the seat is the satellite scope with the ground view (the lab's layout), bodies die on contact, a breach seals after its burn time, and it burns our own walls, towers and the Stalheart too.
outcome: src/fx/laser-arsenal.js runs the domain clock and beam in the game on the unit sphere (R = 10 / cellSide metres): bodies (soft/hard by hp), breaches (killPortal(sp, 'laser'), which now accepts the laser reason), kit walls (storyBase.walls()/dropWall() plus breachWallCell), rock cells, towers (destroyTower), the Stalheart (heartHit) and the tank (playerHit) per LASER_BURN, with per-kind reach metres in LASER_GAME.reach; kills go through damageEnemy with source 'laser'. src/fx/laser-seat.js keeps the owner-approved lab layout: ground view large (groundBack 120 m, groundUp 60 m, 52 degree lens), framed so the contact sits in the open part of the view, and the round scope bottom left, kept clear of the views strip. Mouse hover/drag in the scope aims, mouse button, Space or HOLD burns, WASD glides while off and drags with the beam's inertia while burning, Esc or TANK leaves and restores fov 68. src/fx/laser-station.js composes both for td-tab and catches the strip's SOL-82 button (data-view=laser; first seat behind SOL-82's briefing, paused). The strip shows SOL-82 mm:ss, SOL-82 OVERHEAD lit, amber under a quarter of energy (domain laserStrip). Online with ?laser=online or LASER_GAME.online; storyApi.setLaserOnline(bool) for the sectors. Isao's laser_pass brief on arrival. The game scope calls range at LASER_GAME.range 640 m instead of the lab's 320 m because the game's breaches open about 520 m out. The lab's scope and inset HUD moved to src/fx (laser-scope.js, laser-inset-hud.js) and the lab uses them. td-tab net -10 lines: the briefing cards moved to src/fx/briefing-cards.js.
alternatives: Invert the layout (scope full screen, ground as inset); rejected: the owner approved ground-large in the lab, and the column, smoke and scorch read best large.
Limit v1 to kit walls and bodies for fear of the rock-breach hitch; not needed: the game's board surface patches cells in place and a rock break measured 0.5-0.7 ms.
Keep the lab's 320 m range call in the game; rejected: every game breach would read OUT OF RANGE while the beam seals it.
A data-mount strip button like the gunship; rejected: --defense counts data-mount buttons as tower mounts.
evidence: npm test (107 programs, test/orbital-laser.mjs pins LASER_GAME, inFootprint and laserStrip) and npm run check green on e6c46fb3.

scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --laser-game: PASS laser-game-load, -seat, -burn, -sealed, -tank, -friendly; 19 bodies, 1 breach sealed, 1 rock (slowest break 0.7 ms), 2 of our wall segments with OURS UNDER THE BEAM shown, TANK and Esc restore fov 68, no browser errors.
--defense passes on the branch (strip change does not disturb its mount count).

--laser (the lab) fails at 'the beam cut the wall (0)' after burning only 1 queue body; the lab's feel commits (inertia, 500 fleeing bodies) were never browser-verified, so this is probably pre-existing, but it was not confirmed against the base commit.
Not verified: SITREP hide (CSS only), portrait layout, touch HOLD, tower and Stalheart friendly fire at runtime.
